about: Gate D.3 poll result vectors (V3.2 execution plan §4, D-47, owner ruling in Issue #9). Results come from per-block answer counts and eligible households per block. Defaults: at least 3 answers and 5 households for any grouping; the breakdown of a grouping is shown only if every option count is 0 or at least 3 and so is every option's complement, otherwise the whole breakdown is withheld (turnout only, options: null). A block is shown only if the whole audience's breakdown is, its own is safe, and the audience minus every set of shown blocks is safe too. 'options' maps option id to count; 'blocks' maps block code to its total.

cases.name: two answers: nothing is shown, not even the turnout
an audience of four households: nothing is shown
three answers split 2–1: turnout only, the whole breakdown withheld
six answers split 5–1: turnout only (masking the 1 alone would leave it derivable as 6 − 5)
six answers split 3–3 in one block: shown, no block line (it would repeat the total)
both blocks safe and each difference safe: the audience and both blocks shown
several blocks, one with a small option (B: 5–1): the audience shown; no block, since site − A would equal B
site minus block: A (4–4) is safe on its own, but site − A = B (3–1) is not, so A is not shown
adjacent blocks: A and B safe, C (2–1) not; showing A and B would reveal C as site − A − B, so only one of them is shown
a block with answers but too few households is never shown, nor the audience minus it
zero-count options with a small one (4–0–2): the whole breakdown withheld, so neither the 2 nor the 0 can be used to work it out
a zero-count option beside counts of 3 or more (4–3–0) is shown: no option or complement is one or two people
the published gym poll (31 answers): the audience and both blocks are safe and shown
a tenant may raise the thresholds (never lower): 5 answers under a threshold of 6 show nothing
a raised threshold applies to options too: 8 answers split 4–4 under a threshold of 5 are turnout only
